_about: AGENT-PLAN-1: what a real codex-cli 0.160.0 app-server sent (private CODEX_HOME, scripted fake Responses model on the Mac; paths, model name and the built-in mode prompts redacted). `plan`: a Default turn, then thread/settings/update to Plan, a Plan turn (request_user_input, then a <proposed_plan> answer), a Plan turn with an effort override. `leave`: after an app-server restart, thread/settings/update to Default and 'Implement the plan.'. `gate`: the same calls on a connection initialized without experimentalApi. `review`: a Default turn, then review/start (uncommittedChanges, then custom) - note turn/started carries another id than the review's items and turn/completed. `compact`: a turn, then thread/compact/start (a contextCompaction turn).
